_about: Seed set for scripts/omnibar-acceptance.mjs. Built from DSP_Circulars_Query_Test_Set.pdf (SS, EDS, INT),  HANDOFF_dsp-intranet_query-log.md (A, B, K, H, F, HC), HANDOFF_dsp-intranet_master.md section 5.1 (S), scripts/circular-battery.mjs (CB) and six new observe-only probes (G). Edit freely: prune, add, correct. Fields: id, query, area, expectedRoute (route | [routes] | 'ANY'), expectedFacts (all must appear; an inner list = any one), forbiddenFacts, rowHas (rows of tokens that must sit in ONE row of the answer), expectedCount {of: count|rows|people|holidays|details|results, n}, synthesis (true = the question must be recognised as EDS-type; every other record must NOT be), circular (the battery's rules), lastKnown, source, regression (verified on screen: must never break), timeSensitive, pendingDecision (observed, not judged), requires (flags for --with), run {mode, auth: exec|none, ticket (only to probe a spoofed ticket)}, forbiddenRoutes, notes.
_routes: NOT-FOUND (an empty list or a clarify card)
_notIncluded: 'why is there no health check-up data for this circular?' (its context was lost)
queries the user typed only in screenshots (to be added by the user, source: user)
the 'three bonus stress cases' mentioned in the master handoff (not recoverable)
